Cellular differentiation describes cells in a tissue developing specific structures and capabilities to perform different, essential roles, contributing together in multicelled organism functions and maintenance.
Cells initially start with the basic genetic instruction of being pluripoletential- they possess genes capable and necessary across the entire body (e.g all cell DNA contains heart genes). As these cells move through an organisms' developing and matulating process they become increasingly influenced and restricted based their location
